1.name: Big Root
1.desc_en: Increases the healing effect of Absorb, Aqua Ring, Drain Punch, Draining Kiss, Dream Eater, Giga Drain, Horn Leech, Ingrain, Leech Life, Leech Seed, Mega Drain, Oblivion Wing, and Parabolic Charge used by the holder by 30%.
1.desc_zh: 携带后，吸取ＨＰ的招式可以比平时更多地回复自己的ＨＰ。

2.name: Blue Scarf
2.desc_en: Increases the holder's Beauty stat in contests.
2.desc_zh: 携带它去参加华丽大赛的宝可梦会比平时看上去更加美丽。

3.name: Bright Powder
3.desc_zh: 闪闪发光的粉末。携带后，光芒会迷惑对手，从而使其招式变得不容易命中。

4.name: Choice Band
4.desc_en: Increases the holder's Attack by 50%, but prevents it from changing moves until it switches out.
4.desc_zh: 有点讲究的头带。虽然携带后攻击会提高，但只能使出相同的招式。

5.name: Choice Scarf
5.desc_en: Increases the holder's Speed by 50%, but prevents it from changing moves until it switches out.
5.desc_zh: 有点讲究的围巾。虽然携带后速度会提高，但只能使出相同的招式。

6.name: Choice Specs
6.desc_en: Increases the holder's Special Attack by 50%, but prevents it from changing moves until it switches out.
6.desc_zh: 有点讲究的眼镜。虽然携带后特攻会提高，但只能使出相同的招式。

7.name: Destiny Knot
7.desc_en: When the holder becomes infatuted with the opponent, the opponent will become infatuated with the holder.
7.desc_zh: 长长的鲜红色细线。携带后，在自己着迷时能让对手也着迷。

8.name: Expert Belt
8.desc_en: Increases power of super-effective moves used by the holder by 20%.
8.desc_zh: 用惯了的黑色带子。携带后，效果绝佳时的招式威力就会少量提高。

9.name: Focus Band
9.desc_en: When an attack would knock out the holder, it has a 10% chance to resist with 1 HP instead.
9.desc_zh: 携带后，即便受到可能会导致濒死的招式，有时也能仅以１ＨＰ撑过去。

10.name: Focus Sash
10.desc_en: When an attack would knock out the holder from full health, it will always resist with 1 HP instead. Consumed after use.
10.desc_zh: 携带后，在ＨＰ全满时，即便受到可能会导致濒死的招式，也能仅以１ＨＰ撑过去１次。

11.name: Full Incense
11.desc_en: Ensures that the holder will move last in its priority bracket. If held by a Snorlax when breeding, the egg will hatch into a Munchlax.
11.desc_zh: 有着神奇香气的薰香。携带后，宝可梦的行动会比平时更加迟缓。

12.name: Green Scarf
12.desc_en: Increases the holder's Smartness stat in contests.
12.desc_zh: 携带它去参加华丽大赛的宝可梦会比平时看上去更加聪明。

13.name: Lagging Tail
13.desc_en: Ensures that the holder will move last in its priority bracket.
13.desc_zh: 非常沉重的某种尾巴。携带后，行动会比平时更加迟缓。

14.name: Lax Incense
14.desc_en: Increases the holder's evasion by 10%. If held by a Wobbuffet when breeding, the egg will hatch into a Wynaut.
14.desc_zh: 携带后，薰香的神奇香气会迷惑对手，其招式会变得不容易命中。

15.name: Leftovers
15.desc_en: Restores the holder's HP by 6.125% of its max at the end of each turn.
15.desc_zh: 携带后，宝可梦的ＨＰ会在战斗期间缓缓回复。

16.name: Luck Incense
16.desc_en: When the holder participates in a trainer battle, doubles the amount of money received at the end of it. If held by a Chansey or Blissey when breeding, the egg will hatch into a Happiny.
16.desc_zh: 只要携带它的宝可梦在战斗时出场一次，就能获得２倍金钱。

17.name: Mental Herb
17.desc_en: Automatically cures the holder of being infatuated, or being under the effect of Taunt, Encore, Torment and Disable. Consumed after use.
17.desc_zh: 当携带它的宝可梦无法自由使出招式时，仅会回复１次。

18.name: Metal Powder
18.desc_en: When held by Ditto, increases its Defense and Special Defense by 50%. If Ditto transforms, it is considered a different species so the boosts are lost.
18.desc_zh: 让百变怪携带后，防御就会提高的神奇粉末。非常细腻坚硬。

19.name: Muscle Band
19.desc_en: Increases power of physical moves used by the holder by 10%.
19.desc_zh: 力如泉涌的头带。携带后，物理招式的威力就会少量提高。

20.name: Odd Incense
20.desc_en: Increases power of Psychic-type moves used by the holder by 20%. If held by a Mr. Mime when breeding, the egg will hatch into a Mime Jr.
20.desc_zh: 有着神奇香气的薰香。携带后，超能力属性的招式威力就会提高。

21.name: Pink Scarf
21.desc_en: Increases the holder's Cuteness stat in contests.
21.desc_zh: 携带它去参加华丽大赛的宝可梦会比平时看上去更加可爱。

22.name: Power Herb
22.desc_en: Automatically lets the holder skip the charge turn of two-turn moves. Consumed after use.
22.desc_zh: 携带它的宝可梦仅有１次机会可以在第１回合使出需要蓄力的招式。

23.name: Pure Incense
23.desc_en: If held by the first Pokémon in the party, lowers wild encounter rate. If held by a Chimecho when breeding, the egg will hatch into a Chingling.
23.desc_zh: 让排在最前面的宝可梦携带后，野生宝可梦就会不容易出现。

24.name: Quick Powder
24.desc_en: When held by Ditto, increases its Speed by 100%. If Ditto transforms, it is considered a different species so the boost is lost.
24.desc_zh: 让百变怪携带后，速度就会提高的神奇粉末。非常细腻坚硬。

25.name: Reaper Cloth
25.desc_en: If held by Dusclops during a trade, makes it evolve into Dusknoir.
25.desc_zh: 蕴含着惊人强大灵力的布。某种宝可梦很喜欢它。

26.name: Red Scarf
26.desc_en: Increases the holder's Coolness stat in contests.
26.desc_zh: 携带它去参加华丽大赛的宝可梦会比平时看上去更加帅气。

27.name: Rock Incense
27.desc_en: Increases power of Rock-type moves used by the holder by 20%. If held by a Sudowoodo when breeding, the egg will hatch into a Bonsly.
27.desc_zh: 有着神奇香气的薰香。携带后，岩石属性的招式威力就会提高。

28.name: Rose Incense
28.desc_en: Increases power of Grass-type moves used by the holder by 20%. If held by a Roselia or Roserade when breeding, the egg will hatch into a Budew.
28.desc_zh: 有着神奇香气的薰香。携带后，草属性的招式威力就会提高。

29.name: Sea Incense
29.desc_en: Increases power of Water-type moves used by the holder by 20%. If held by a Marill or Azumarill when breeding, the egg will hatch into an Azurill.
29.desc_zh: 有着神奇香气的薰香。携带后，水属性的招式威力就会提高。

30.name: Shed Shell
30.desc_en: Always allows the holder to switch out, regardless of trapping effects.
30.desc_zh: 结实坚硬的空壳。携带它的宝可梦必定可以和后备的宝可梦进行替换。

31.name: Silk Scarf
31.desc_en: Increases power of Normal-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
31.desc_zh: 手感不错的围巾。携带后，一般属性的招式威力就会提高。

32.name: Silver Powder
32.desc_en: Increases power of Bug-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
32.desc_zh: 散发着银色光辉的粉末。携带后，虫属性的招式威力就会提高。

33.name: Smooth Rock
33.desc_en: When the holder uses Sandstorm, increases its duration from 5 turns to 8 turns.
33.desc_zh: 携带它的宝可梦使出沙暴的话，沙暴的时间就会比平时更长。

34.name: Soft Sand
34.desc_en: Increases power of Ground-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
34.desc_zh: 手感细腻的沙子。携带后，地面属性的招式威力就会提高。

35.name: Soothe Bell
35.desc_en: Doubles the effectiveness of any action that raises the holder's happiness.
35.desc_zh: 音色悦耳的铃铛。携带它的宝可梦会受到安抚，变得容易和训练家亲密。

36.name: Wave Incense
36.desc_en: Increases power of Water-type moves used by the holder by 20%. If held by a Mantine when breeding, the egg will hatch into a Mantyke.
36.desc_zh: 有着神奇香气的薰香。携带后，水属性的招式威力就会提高。

37.name: White Herb
37.desc_en: Automatically reverts any stat drop caused on the holder. If multiple stats were lowered by the same effect, will revert all of them. Consumed after use.
37.desc_zh: 当携带它的宝可梦能力降低时，仅能回到之前的状态１次。

38.name: Wide Lens
38.desc_zh: 能放大观看物体的镜片。携带后，招式的命中率就会少量提高。

39.name: Wise Glasses
39.desc_en: Increases power of special moves used by the holder by 10%.
39.desc_zh: 装着很厚镜片的眼镜。携带后，特殊招式的威力就会少量提高。

40.name: Yellow Scarf
40.desc_en: Increases the holder's Toughness stat in contests.
40.desc_zh: 携带它去参加华丽大赛的宝可梦会比平时看上去更加强壮。

41.name: Zoom Lens
41.desc_en: Increases the holder's accuracy by 20% if it moves after the enemy.
41.desc_zh: 当携带它的宝可梦比对手行动迟缓时，招式会变得容易命中。

42.name: Amulet Coin
42.desc_en: When the holder participates in a trainer battle, doubles the amount of money received at the end of it.
42.desc_zh: 只要携带它的宝可梦在战斗时出场一次，就能获得２倍金钱。

43.name: Antidote
43.desc_zh: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的中毒状态。

44.name: Awakening
44.desc_zh: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的睡眠状态。

45.name: Berry Juice
45.desc_en: Automatically restores 20 HP to the holder when it falls below 50% of its max HP.
45.desc_zh: １００％树果果汁。能让１只宝可梦回复２０ＨＰ。

46.name: Big Pearl
46.desc_en: A quite-large pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
46.desc_zh: 散发着美丽银辉且相当大颗的珍珠。可以在商店高价出售。

47.name: Big Mushroom
47.desc_en: A large and rare mushroom. It is sought after by collectors.
47.desc_zh: 珍稀的大蘑菇。在一些爱好者中有着非常高的人气。

48.name: Black Belt
48.desc_en: Increases power of Fighting-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
48.desc_zh: 能振作精神的带子。携带后，格斗属性的招式威力就会提高。

49.name: Black Flute
49.desc_en: A toy flute made from black glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
49.desc_zh: 以黑色玻璃制成的哨子。在使用的地方更容易遇到强大的宝可梦。

50.name: Black Sludge
50.desc_en: If held by a Poison-type Pokémon, restores 6.125% of its max HP at the end of every turn. Otherwise, damages the holder for 6.125% of its max HP at the end of every turn.
50.desc_zh: 携带后，毒属性的宝可梦会缓缓回复ＨＰ。其他属性的话，ＨＰ则会减少。

51.name: Black Glasses
51.desc_en: Increases power of Dark-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
51.desc_zh: 看上去很奇怪的眼镜。携带后，恶属性的招式威力就会提高。

52.name: Blue Flute
52.desc_en: A toy flute made from blue glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
52.desc_zh: 以蓝色玻璃制成的哨子。可以治愈睡眠状态。

53.name: Blue Shard
53.desc_en: A small blue shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.
53.desc_zh: 蓝色的小碎片。好像是以前制作的某道具的一部分。

54.name: Burn Heal
54.desc_en: Cures a Pokémon of a Burn.
54.desc_zh: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的灼伤状态。

55.name: Calcium
55.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Special Attack EVs by 10, but won't raise them above 100.
55.desc_zh: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的特攻的基础点数。

56.name: Carbos
56.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Speed EVs by 10, but won't raise them above 100.
56.desc_zh: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的速度的基础点数。

57.name: Charcoal
57.desc_en: Increases power of Fire-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
57.desc_zh: 焚烧用的燃料。携带后，火属性的招式威力就会提高。

58.name: Cleanse Tag
58.desc_en: If held by the first Pokémon in the party, lowers wild encounter rate.
58.desc_zh: 让排在最前面的宝可梦携带后，野生宝可梦就会不容易出现。

59.name: Damp Mulch
59.desc_en: Increases Berry growth time by 25%, but makes soil dry slower. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
59.desc_zh: 培育树果时的肥料。但完全不适合丰缘地区的土壤，所以没什么效果。

60.name: Deep Sea Scale
60.desc_en: When held by Clamperl, increases its Special Defense by 100%. If held by Clamperl during a trade, makes it evolve into Gorebyss.
60.desc_zh: 让珍珠贝携带后，特防就会提高的鳞片。散发着淡淡的粉红色光芒。

61.name: Dire Hit
61.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's critical hit ratio by 1 stage and increases its happiness.
61.desc_zh: 击中要害的几率会大幅提高。只能使用１次。离场后，效果便会消失。

62.name: Dragon Scale
62.desc_en: Increases power of Dragon-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
62.desc_zh: 又硬又坚固的鳞片。龙属性宝可梦有时会携带它。

63.name: Elixir
63.desc_en: Restores 10 PP to all of a Pokémon's moves.
63.desc_zh: 能让宝可梦学会的４个招式各回复１０ＰＰ。

64.name: Energy Root
64.desc_en: Restores 200 HP to a Pokémon, but lowers its happiness.
64.desc_zh: 非常苦的根。能让１只宝可梦回复１２０ＨＰ。

65.name: Energy Powder
65.desc_en: Restores 50 HP to a Pokémon, but lowers its happiness.
65.desc_zh: 非常苦的药粉。能让１只宝可梦回复６０ＨＰ。

66.name: Escape Rope
66.desc_en: When used in a cave or a dungeon, teleports the user to the entrance they used to enter it.
66.desc_zh: 结实的长绳。可以从洞窟或迷宫中脱身。

67.name: Ether
67.desc_en: Restores 10 PP to one of a Pokémon's moves.
67.desc_zh: 能让宝可梦学会的其中１个招式回复１０ＰＰ。

68.name: Everstone
68.desc_en: Prevents the holder from evolving by level up. When held by a female Pokémon in the Day Care Center, it has a 50% chance of passing the holder's nature to the baby.
68.desc_zh: 携带后，宝可梦在此期间不会进化的神奇石头。

69.name: Exp. Share
69.desc_en: Lets the user gain half of the experience points it wouldn't have gained every time experience points are awarded.
69.desc_zh: 携带的宝可梦就算没有参与对战也能分享到经验值的便利装置。

70.name: Fire Stone
70.desc_en: Evolves Vulpix into Ninetales, Growlithe into Arcanine, Eevee into Flareon and Pansear into Simisear.
70.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。看上去是橙黄色的。

71.name: Flame Orb
71.desc_en: Unless the holder cannot be burned, inflicts the holder with a Burn at the end of a turn.
71.desc_zh: 触碰后会放出热量的神奇宝珠。携带后，在战斗时会变成灼伤状态。

72.name: Fluffy Tail
72.desc_en: Guarantees escape from wild battles when used.
72.desc_zh: 能吸引宝可梦注意的道具。在和野生宝可梦的战斗中绝对可以逃走。

73.name: Fresh Water
73.desc_zh: 富含矿物质的水。能让１只宝可梦回复３０ＨＰ。

74.name: Full Heal
74.desc_en: Cures a Pokémon of any major status condition.
74.desc_zh: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

75.name: Full Restore
75.desc_en: Cures a Pokémon of any major status condition, and restores all of its HP.
75.desc_zh: 能回复１只宝可梦的所有ＨＰ并治愈所有异常状态。

76.name: Gooey Mulch
76.desc_en: Increases the number of times withered plants will grow again. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
76.desc_zh: 培育树果时的肥料。但完全不适合丰缘地区的土壤，所以没什么效果。

77.name: Green Shard
77.desc_en: A small green shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.
77.desc_zh: 绿色的小碎片。好像是以前制作的某道具的一部分。

78.name: Growth Mulch
78.desc_en: Decreases Berry growth time by 25%, but makes soil dry quicker. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
78.desc_zh: 培育树果时的肥料。但完全不适合丰缘地区的土壤，所以没什么效果。

79.name: Guard Spec.
79.desc_en: Prevents stat reductions for the Trainer's party for 5 turns when used.
79.desc_zh: 在战斗中，５回合内不让我方能力降低的道具。

80.name: Heal Powder
80.desc_en: Cures a Pokémon of any major status condition, but lowers its happiness.
80.desc_zh: 非常苦的药粉。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

81.name: Heart Scale
81.desc_en: A pretty, heart-shaped scale that is extremely rare. It glows faintly in the colors of the rainbow.
81.desc_zh: 有着美丽心形外形且非常珍稀的鳞片。有些人收到会很高兴。

82.name: Honey
82.desc_en: When used, immediately attracts a wild Pokémon.
82.desc_zh: 在草丛或洞窟等地方使用后，被甜甜香气吸引的野生宝可梦就会出现。

83.name: HP Up
83.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's HP EVs by 10, but won't raise them above 100.
83.desc_zh: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的ＨＰ的基础点数。

84.name: Hyper Potion
84.desc_zh: 喷雾式伤药。能让１只宝可梦回复１２０ＨＰ。

85.name: Ice Heal
85.desc_en: Cures a Pokémon of being Frozen.
85.desc_zh: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的冰冻状态。

86.name: Iron
86.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Defense EVs by 10, but won't raise them above 100.
86.desc_zh: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的防御的基础点数。

87.name: King's Rock
87.desc_en: Adds a 10% chance to flinch the target to all of the holder's moves that cannot already cause flinching. Affected by Serene Grace. If held by Poliwhirl during a trade, makes it evolve into Poliwrath. If held by Slowpoke during a trade, makes it evolve into Slowking.
87.desc_zh: 携带后进行攻击，在造成伤害时，有时会让对手畏缩。

88.name: Lava Cookie
88.desc_en: Cures a Pokémon of any major status condition.
88.desc_zh: 釜炎特产的仙贝。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

89.name: Leaf Stone
89.desc_en: Evolves Gloom into Vileplume, Weepinbell into Victreebel, Exeggcute into Exeggutor, Nuzleaf into Shiftry and Pansage into Simisage.
89.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。有着叶子般的花纹。

90.name: Lemonade
90.desc_zh: 非常香甜的牛奶。能让１只宝可梦回复７０ＨＰ。

91.name: Life Orb
91.desc_en: Boosts the power of all moves used by the holder by 30%, but damages it for 10% its max HP every time it attacks. The self-damage doesn't happen if the holder has Sheer Force and uses a move boosted by it.
91.desc_zh: 携带后，虽然每次攻击时ＨＰ少量减少，但招式的威力会提高。

92.name: Light Ball
92.desc_en: When held by Pikachu, increases its Attack and Special Attack by 100%. If held by Pikachu or Raichu when breeding, the baby Pichu will know Volt Tackle.
92.desc_zh: 让皮卡丘携带后，攻击和特攻的威力就会提高的神奇之球。

93.name: Light Clay
93.desc_en: When the holder uses Reflect or Light Screen, increases its duration from 5 turns to 8 turns.
93.desc_zh: 当携带它的宝可梦使出光墙或反射壁时，效果会比平时持续得更长。

94.name: Lucky Egg
94.desc_en: Increases experience gained by the holder by 50%.
94.desc_zh: 满载着幸福的蛋。携带它的宝可梦获得的经验值会少量增加。

95.name: Magnet
95.desc_en: Increases power of Electric-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
95.desc_zh: 强力的磁铁。携带后，电属性的招式威力就会提高。

96.name: Max Elixir
96.desc_en: Restores all PP to all of a Pokémon's moves.
96.desc_zh: 能让宝可梦学会的４个招式回复所有ＰＰ。

97.name: Max Ether
97.desc_en: Restores all PP to one of a Pokémon's moves.
97.desc_zh: 能让宝可梦学会的其中１个招式回复所有ＰＰ。

98.name: Max Potion
98.desc_en: Restores all HP to a Pokémon.
98.desc_zh: 喷雾式伤药。能让１只宝可梦回复所有ＨＰ。

99.name: Max Repel
99.desc_en: When used, prevents wild encounters for 250 steps.
99.desc_zh: 弱小的野生宝可梦将完全不会出现。效果比白银喷雾更持久。

100.name: Max Revive
100.desc_en: Revives a fainted Pokémon with all of its HP.
100.desc_zh: 能让１只陷入濒死的宝可梦重获生机，并回复所有ＨＰ。

101.name: Metal Coat
101.desc_en: Increases power of Steel-type moves used by the holder by 20%. If held by Onix during a trade, makes it evolve into Steelix. If held by Scyther during a trade, makes it evolve into Scizor.
101.desc_zh: 特殊的金属膜。携带后，钢属性的招式威力就会提高。

102.name: Metronome
102.desc_en: For each time the holder uses the same move in a row, that move's power is increased by 20%, up to a maximum of 100%. (For Generations 4 and under, the boost is 10% per usage).
102.desc_zh: 携带后，连续使出相同招式时，威力就会提高。不再使出相同招式时，威力就会复原。

103.name: Miracle Seed
103.desc_en: Increases power of Grass-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
103.desc_zh: 孕育生命的种子。携带后，草属性的招式威力就会提高。

104.name: Moomoo Milk
104.desc_zh: 营养百分百的牛奶。能让１只宝可梦回复１００ＨＰ。

105.name: Moon Stone
105.desc_en: Evolves Nidorina into Nidoqueen, Nidorino into Nidoking, Clefairy into Clefable, Jigglypuff into Wigglytuff, Skitty into Delcatty and Munna into Musharna.
105.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像夜空一样乌黑。

106.name: Mystic Water
106.desc_en: Increases power of Water-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
106.desc_zh: 水滴形状的宝石。携带后，水属性的招式威力就会提高。

107.name: Never-Melt Ice
107.desc_en: Increases power of Ice-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
107.desc_zh: 能隔绝热量的冰。携带后，冰属性的招式威力就会提高。

108.name: Nugget
108.desc_en: A nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
108.desc_zh: 闪着金光，以纯金制成的珠子。可以在商店高价出售。

109.name: Old Gateau
109.desc_en: Cures a Pokémon of any major status condition.
109.desc_zh: 百代不为人知的特产。能治愈１只宝可梦的所有异常状态。

110.name: Paralyze Heal
110.desc_zh: 喷雾式药水。能治愈１只宝可梦的麻痹状态。

111.name: Pearl
111.desc_en: A somewhat-small pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold cheaply to shops.
111.desc_zh: 散发着美丽银辉且有点小的珍珠。可以在商店低价出售。

112.name: Poké Doll
112.desc_en: Guarantees escape from wild battles when used.
112.desc_zh: 能吸引宝可梦注意的道具。在和野生宝可梦的战斗中绝对可以逃走。

113.name: Potion
113.desc_zh: 喷雾式伤药。能让１只宝可梦回复２０ＨＰ。

114.name: PP Max
114.desc_en: Increases a move's max PP to 8/5 of its original max.
114.desc_zh: 能将宝可梦学会的其中１个招式的ＰＰ最大值提至最高。

115.name: PP Up
115.desc_en: Increases a move's max PP by 1/5 of its original max, up to a total of 8/5.
115.desc_zh: 能让宝可梦学会的其中１个招式的ＰＰ最大值少量提高。

116.name: Protein
116.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Attack EVs by 10, but won't raise them above 100.
116.desc_zh: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的攻击的基础点数。

117.name: Rare Candy
117.desc_zh: 充满能量的糖果。将它交给宝可梦后，１只宝可梦的等级仅会提高１。

118.name: Razor Fang
118.desc_en: Adds a 10% chance to flinch the target to all of the holder's moves that cannot already cause flinching. Affected by Serene Grace. If held by Gligar at night while it levels up, makes it evolve into Gliscor.
118.desc_zh: 尖锐的牙齿。携带后，在给予伤害时，有时会让对手畏缩。

119.name: Red Flute
119.desc_en: A toy flute made from red glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
119.desc_zh: 以红色玻璃制成的哨子。可以治愈着迷状态。

120.name: Red Shard
120.desc_en: A small red shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.
120.desc_zh: 红色的小碎片。好像是以前制作的某道具的一部分。

121.name: Repel
121.desc_en: When used, prevents wild encounters for 100 steps.
121.desc_zh: 使用后，在较短的一段时间内，弱小的野生宝可梦将完全不会出现。

122.name: Revival Herb
122.desc_en: Revives a fainted Pokémon with all of its HP, but lowers its friendship.
122.desc_zh: 非常苦的药草。能让１只濒死的宝可梦回复所有ＨＰ。

123.name: Revive
123.desc_en: Revives a fainted Pokémon with 50% of its HP.
123.desc_zh: 能让１只陷入濒死的宝可梦重获生机，并回复一半ＨＰ。

124.name: Sacred Ash
124.desc_en: Revives all fainted Pokémon with all of their HP.
124.desc_zh: 能让陷入濒死的全部宝可梦回复所有ＨＰ。

125.name: Scope Lens
125.desc_en: Increases the holder's critical hit ratio by 1 stage.
125.desc_zh: 能看见弱点的镜片。携带它的宝可梦的招式会变得容易击中要害。

126.name: Shell Bell
126.desc_en: Every time the holder attacks, restores its HP by 12.5% of the damage dealt to the opponent.
126.desc_zh: 当携带它的宝可梦攻击对手并造成伤害时，能回复少量ＨＰ。

127.name: Shoal Salt
127.desc_en: Pure salt that can be discovered deep inside the Shoal Cave. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
127.desc_zh: 在浅滩洞穴这地方找到的海盐。

128.name: Shoal Shell
128.desc_en: A pretty seashell that can be found deep inside the Shoal Cave. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
128.desc_zh: 在浅滩洞穴这地方找到的贝壳。

129.name: Smoke Ball
129.desc_en: Guarantees that the holder can always escape from wild Pokémon.
129.desc_zh: 携带它的宝可梦在和野生宝可梦的战斗中绝对可以逃走。

130.name: Soda Pop
130.desc_zh: 翻腾着气泡的汽水。能让１只宝可梦回复５０ＨＰ。

131.name: Soul Dew
131.desc_en: When held by Latias or Latios, increases the power of Dragon-type and Psychic-type moves by 20%.
131.desc_zh: 让拉帝欧斯或拉帝亚斯携带后，超能力和龙属性的招式威力就会提高的神奇珠子。

132.name: Spell Tag
132.desc_en: Increases power of Ghost-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
132.desc_zh: 古怪可怕的咒符。携带后，幽灵属性的招式威力就会提高。

133.name: Stable Mulch
133.desc_en: Increases the time Berries will remain on a plant before withering. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
133.desc_zh: 培育树果时的肥料。但完全不适合丰缘地区的土壤，所以没什么效果。

134.name: Star Piece
134.desc_en: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red color. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
134.desc_zh: 闪着红光且十分美丽的宝石碎片。可以在商店高价出售。

135.name: Stardust
135.desc_en: Lovely, red-colored sand with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
135.desc_zh: 手感细腻且十分美丽的红色沙子。可以在商店低价出售。

136.name: Sun Stone
136.desc_en: Evolves Gloom into Bellossom, Sunkern into Sunflora, Cottonee into Whimsicott and Petilil into Lilligant.
136.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像太阳一样赤红。

137.name: Super Potion
137.desc_zh: 喷雾式伤药。能让１只宝可梦回复６０ＨＰ。

138.name: Super Repel
138.desc_en: When used, prevents wild encounters for 100 steps.
138.desc_zh: 弱小的野生宝可梦将完全不会出现。效果比除虫喷雾更持久。

139.name: Thunder Stone
139.desc_en: Evolves Pikachu into Raichu, Eevee into Jolteon and Eelektrik into Eelektross.
139.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。有着闪电般的花纹。

140.name: Tiny Mushroom
140.desc_en: A small and rare mushroom. It is sought after by collectors.
140.desc_zh: 珍稀的小蘑菇。在一些爱好者中有着相当高的人气。

141.name: Toxic Orb
141.desc_en: Unless the holder cannot be poisoned, inflicts the holder with Toxic Poison at the end of a turn.
141.desc_zh: 触碰后会放出毒的神奇宝珠。携带后，在战斗时会变成剧毒状态。

142.name: Twisted Spoon
142.desc_en: Increases power of Psychic-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
142.desc_zh: 注入了念力的汤匙。携带后，超能力属性的招式威力就会提高。

143.name: Up-Grade
143.desc_en: If held by Porygon during a trade, makes it evolve into Porygon2.
143.desc_zh: 内部储存了各种信息的透明机器。西尔佛公司制造。

144.name: Water Stone
144.desc_en: Evolves Poliwhirl into Poliwrath, Shellder into Cloyster, Staryu into Starmie, Eevee into Vaporeon, Lombre into Ludicolo and Panpour into Simipour.
144.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。看上去是澄蓝色的。

145.name: White Flute
145.desc_en: A toy flute made from white glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
145.desc_zh: 以白色玻璃制成的哨子。在使用的地方更容易遇到弱小的宝可梦。

146.name: X Accuracy
146.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's accuracy by 1 stage.
146.desc_zh: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦命中的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

147.name: X Attack
147.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Attack by 1 stage.
147.desc_zh: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦攻击的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

148.name: X Defend
148.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Defense by 1 stage.
148.desc_zh: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦防御的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

149.name: X Special
149.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Special Attack by 1 stage.
149.desc_zh: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦特攻的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

150.name: X Sp. Def
150.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Special Defense by 1 stage.
150.desc_zh: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦特防的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

151.name: X Speed
151.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Speed by 1 stage.
151.desc_zh: 大幅提高战斗中宝可梦速度的道具。离场后，效果便会消失。

152.name: Yellow Flute
152.desc_en: A toy flute made from yellow glass. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
152.desc_zh: 以黄色玻璃制成的哨子。可以治愈混乱状态。

153.name: Yellow Shard
153.desc_en: A small yellow shard. It appears to be from some sort of implement made long ago.
153.desc_zh: 黄色的小碎片。好像是以前制作的某道具的一部分。

154.name: Zinc
154.desc_en: Increases a Pokémon's Special Defense EVs by 10, but won't raise them above 100.
154.desc_zh: 宝可梦的营养饮料。能提高１只宝可梦的特防的基础点数。

155.name: Icy Rock
155.desc_en: When the holder uses Hail, increases its duration from 5 turns to 8 turns.
155.desc_zh: 携带它的宝可梦使出冰雹的话，冰雹的时间就会比平时更长。

156.name: Lucky Punch
156.desc_en: When held by Chansey, raises its critical hit ratio by 2 stages.
156.desc_zh: 能带来幸运的拳套。让吉利蛋携带后，招式会变得容易击中要害。

157.name: Dubious Disc
157.desc_en: If held by Porygon2 during a trade, makes it evolve into Porygon-Z.
157.desc_zh: 内部储存了奇怪信息的透明机器。制造者不明。

158.name: Sharp Beak
158.desc_en: Increases power of Flying-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
158.desc_zh: 又长又尖的鸟嘴。携带后，飞行属性的招式威力就会提高。

159.name: Adamant Orb
159.desc_en: When held by Dialga, increases the power of its Dragon-type and Steel-type moves by 20%.
159.desc_zh: 让帝牙卢卡携带的话，龙和钢属性的招式威力就会提高。散发着光辉的宝珠。

160.name: Damp Rock
160.desc_en: When the holder uses Rain Dance, increases its duration from 5 turns to 8 turns.
160.desc_zh: 携带它的宝可梦使出求雨的话，下雨的时间就会比平时更长。

161.name: Heat Rock
161.desc_en: When the holder uses Sunny Day, increases its duration from 5 turns to 8 turns.
161.desc_zh: 携带它的宝可梦使出大晴天的话，晴天的时间就会比平时更长。

162.name: Lustrous Orb
162.desc_en: When held by Palkia, increases the power of its Dragon-type and Water-type moves by 20%.
162.desc_zh: 让帕路奇亚携带的话，龙和水属性的招式威力就会提高。散发着美丽光辉的宝珠。

163.name: Macho Brace
163.desc_en: Halves the holder's Speed, but doubles the EVs it gains from battles.
163.desc_zh: 又硬又重的锻炼器。虽然携带后速度会降低，但会比平时更容易茁壮成长。

164.name: Stick
164.desc_en: When held by Farfetch'd, increases its critical hit ratio by 2 stages.
164.desc_zh: 非常长且坚硬的茎。让大葱鸭携带后，招式会变得容易击中要害。

165.name: Dragon Fang
165.desc_en: Increases power of Dragon-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
165.desc_zh: 坚硬锐利的牙齿。携带后，龙属性的招式威力就会提高。

166.name: Poison Barb
166.desc_en: Increases power of Poison-type moves used by the holder by 20%.
166.desc_zh: 有毒的小针。携带后，毒属性的招式威力就会提高。

167.name: Power Anklet
167.desc_en: Halves the holder's Speed, but makes the holder gain 4 Speed EVs from any battle in addition to the normal amount.
167.desc_zh: 虽然携带后速度会降低，但宝可梦的速度会比平时成长得更高。

168.name: Power Band
168.desc_en: Halves the holder's Speed, but makes the holder gain 4 Special Attack EVs from any battle in addition to the normal amount.
168.desc_zh: 虽然携带后速度会降低，但宝可梦的特防会比平时成长得更高。

169.name: Power Belt
169.desc_en: Halves the holder's Speed, but makes the holder gain 4 Defense EVs from any battle in addition to the normal amount.
169.desc_zh: 虽然携带后速度会降低，但宝可梦的防御会比平时成长得更高。

170.name: Power Bracer
170.desc_en: Halves the holder's Speed, but makes the holder gain 4 Attack EVs from any battle in addition to the normal amount.
170.desc_zh: 虽然携带后速度会降低，但宝可梦的攻击会比平时成长得更高。

171.name: Power Lens
171.desc_en: Halves the holder's Speed, but makes the holder gain 4 Special Defense EVs from any battle in addition to the normal amount.
171.desc_zh: 虽然携带后速度会降低，但宝可梦的特攻会比平时成长得更高。

172.name: Power Weight
172.desc_en: Halves the holder's Speed, but makes the holder gain 4 HP EVs from any battle in addition to the normal amount.
172.desc_zh: 虽然携带后速度会降低，但宝可梦的ＨＰ会比平时成长得更高。

173.name: Dawn Stone
173.desc_en: Evolves male Kirlia into Gallade and female Snorunt into Froslass.
173.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像眼眸一般光彩动人。

174.name: Dusk Stone
174.desc_en: Evolves Murkrow into Honchkrow, Misdreavus into Mismagius and Lampent into Chandelure.
174.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像黑夜一般漆黑。

175.name: Electirizer
175.desc_en: If held by Electabuzz during a trade, makes it evolve into Electivire.
175.desc_zh: 积蓄着庞大电气力量的箱子。某种宝可梦很喜欢它。

176.name: Magmarizer
176.desc_en: If held by Magmar during a trade, makes it evolve into Magmortar.
176.desc_zh: 积蓄着庞大熔岩能量的箱子。某种宝可梦很喜欢它。

177.name: Odd Keystone
177.desc_en: A vital item that is needed to keep a stone tower from collapsing. Voices can be heard from it occasionally.
177.desc_zh: 没有它，石之塔就会崩塌的重要石头。有时能从石头里听到声音。

178.name: Oval Stone
178.desc_en: If held by Happiny during the day while it levels up, makes it evolve into Chansey
178.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像珠子一般圆润。

179.name: Protector
179.desc_en: If held by Rhydon during a trade, makes it evolve into Rhyperior.
179.desc_zh: 某种护具。非常坚硬而且沉重。某种宝可梦很喜欢它。

180.name: Quick Claw
180.desc_en: Has a 20% chance to make the holder move first in its priority bracket.
180.desc_zh: 又轻又尖锐的爪子。携带后，有时能比对手先一步行动。

181.name: Razor Claw
181.desc_en: Increases the holder's critical hit ratio by 1 stage. If held by Sneasel during the night while it levels up, makes it evolve into Weavile.
181.desc_zh: 尖锐的爪子。携带后，招式会变得容易击中要害。

182.name: Shiny Stone
182.desc_en: Makes Togetic evolve into Togekiss, Roselia into Roserade and Minccino into Cinccino.
182.desc_zh: 能让某些特定宝可梦进化的神奇石头。像光芒一样耀眼。

183.name: Sticky Barb
183.desc_en: Damages the holder for 12.5% of its max HP at the end of each turn. If another Pokémon hits the holder with a contact move and is not holding an item, this item will transfer to that Pokémon.
183.desc_zh: 携带后，每回合都会受到伤害。有时也会附着到碰到自己的对手身上。

184.name: Deep Sea Tooth
184.desc_en: When held by Clamperl, increases its Special Attack by 100%. If held by Clamperl during a trade, makes it evolve into Huntail.
184.desc_zh: 让珍珠贝携带后，特攻就会提高的牙齿。散发着闪亮的银光。

185.name: Draco Plate
185.desc_en: Increases power of Dragon-type moves used by the holder by 20%. Changes Judgment and Arceus with Multitype to the Dragon type.
185.desc_zh: 龙属性的石板。携带后，龙属性的招式威力就会增强。

186.name: Dread Plate
186.desc_en: Increases power of Dark-type moves used by the holder by 20%. Changes Judgment and Arceus with Multitype to the Dark type.
186.desc_zh: 恶属性的石板。携带后，恶属性的招式威力就会增强。

187.name: Earth Plate
187.desc_en: Increases power of Ground-type moves used by the holder by 20%. Changes Judgment and Arceus with Multitype to the Ground type.
187.desc_zh: 地面属性的石板。携带后，地面属性的招式威力就会增强。

188.name: Fist Plate
188.desc_en: Increases power of Fighting-type moves used by the holder by 20%. Changes Judgment and Arceus with Multitype to the Fighting type.
188.desc_zh: 格斗属性的石板。携带后，格斗属性的招式威力就会增强。

189.name: Flame Plate
189.desc_en: Increases power of Fire-type moves used by the holder by 20%. Changes Judgment and Arceus with Multitype to the Fire type.
189.desc_zh: 火属性的石板。携带后，火属性的招式威力就会增强。

190.name: Grip Claw
190.desc_en: Ensures that partially trapping moves will always have their effect last for 5 turns.
190.desc_zh: 携带后，绑紧以及紧束等会持续造成伤害的招式的回合数会增加。

191.name: Icicle Plate
191.desc_en: Increases power of Ice-type moves used by the holder by 20%. Changes Judgment and Arceus with Multitype to the Ice type.
191.desc_zh: 冰属性的石板。携带后，冰属性的招式威力就会增强。

192.name: Insect Plate
192.desc_en: Increases power of Bug-type moves used by the holder by 20%. Changes Judgment and Arceus with Multitype to the Bug type.
192.desc_zh: 虫属性的石板。携带后，虫属性的招式威力就会增强。

193.name: Iron Plate
193.desc_en: Increases power of Steel-type moves used by the holder by 20%. Changes Judgment and Arceus with Multitype to the Steel type.
193.desc_zh: 钢属性的石板。携带后，钢属性的招式威力就会增强。

194.name: Meadow Plate

310.desc_zh: 有点与众不同的球。要捕捉的宝可梦比自己宝可梦的等级越低，就会越容易捕捉。

311.name: Lure Ball
311.desc_en: If the target was hooked with a fishing rod, has a capture rate of 3. Otherwise, has a capture rate of 1.
311.desc_zh: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉用钓竿钓上来的宝可梦。

312.name: Moon Ball
312.desc_en: If the target belongs to the evolutionary line of a Pokémon that can evolve via Moon stone, has a capture rate of 4. Otherwise, has a capture rate of 1.
312.desc_zh: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉使用月之石进化的宝可梦。

313.name: Friend Ball
313.desc_en: Has a capture rate of 1. Pokémon captured with this Poke Ball have their happiness immediately set to 200.
313.desc_zh: 有点与众不同的球。捉到的野生宝可梦会立刻变得和训练家亲密起来。

314.name: Love Ball

314.desc_zh: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉和自己宝可梦性别不同的宝可梦。

315.name: Heavy Ball

316.name: Fast Ball

316.desc_zh: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉逃跑速度很快的宝可梦。

317.name: Sport Ball
317.desc_en: Has a 1.5 capture rate. Only for use during the Bug-Catching Contest.
317.desc_zh: 在捕虫大赛上使用的特殊的球。

318.name: Premier Ball
318.desc_zh: 有点珍贵的球。特制出来的某种纪念品。

319.name: Repeat Ball

319.desc_zh: 有点与众不同的球。能很容易地捕捉以前曾捉到过的宝可梦。

320.name: Timer Ball

320.desc_zh: 有点与众不同的球。回合数花费得越多，宝可梦就会越容易捕捉。

321.name: Nest Ball

362.name: Terrain Extender

381.desc_zh: 使用声音相关的招式时，特攻会提高。

382.name: Eject Pack

382.desc_zh: 当携带它的宝可梦能力下降时，同行宝可梦就会自动替换上场。

383.name: Heavy-Duty Boots

383.desc_zh: 不受脚下陷阱等的影响。

384.name: Blunder Policy

384.desc_zh: 招式因命中率影响而落空时，速度会大幅提高。
